mapper.select: SELECT dept_id, dept_name, dept_type, manager_id FROM departments WHERE dept_id = #{deptId}
SELECT dept_id, dept_name, dept_type, manager_id FROM departments ORDER BY dept_id
SELECT dept_id, dept_name, dept_type, manager_id FROM departments WHERE manager_id = #{managerId} ORDER BY dept_id
SELECT dept_id, dept_name, dept_type, manager_id FROM departments WHERE dept_type = #{deptType} LIMIT 1

SELECT d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_type, d.manager_id, e.employee_code AS manager_code, e.employee_name AS manager_name FROM departments d INNER JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = d.manager_id WHERE e.status = 'INACTIVE' ORDER BY d.dept_id
